plugins.description: DSH plugin: let an Agent Teams Lead choose the provider, model, and reasoning effort of each teammate it spawns.
plugins.readme_text:
# Team Model Routing (`dsh-plugin-team-model-routing`)

Let an Agent Teams **Lead** choose the `provider`, `model`, and
`reasoning_effort` of each teammate it spawns, validated against the Subagent
model-selection allowlist.

## Why it needs a plugin

`spawn_teammate` (shipped) carries no route fields, and
`ctx.agentTeams.spawnTeammate()` forwards only a provider *name* to
`ctx.subagents.startContinuable()`, which is where `agentOptions` live.

A teammate is a **continuable** child: the continuation registry materializes it
through `ctx.agents.create()` and **never calls a subagent provider's
`start()`**. So wrapping a subagent provider (the obvious first idea) can never
route a teammate — the wrapper is simply never asked to start it, and the
teammate silently ends up on the inherited route.

## The seam that works

```
spawn_teammate_routed            record route by (Lead, teammate name, context)
        ↓
agentTeams.spawnTeammate(...)    shipped Team service, unchanged contract
        ↓
ctx.agents.create()              child materialized; initial prompt queued to inbox
        ↓
agent/pre-step (child scope)     ← plugin: claim route, rewrite child.options
        ↓
AgentLoop.prepareRequest()       reads this.options → request/header + assistant
                                 message source + every later step
```

Two facts make this work, both verified in the installed sources:

- `agent/pre-step` is an awaited waterfall that runs **before** `step()` →
  `prepareRequest()` (`dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:902-925 → 978 → 1050`).
- `prepareRequest()` reads `this.options` on **every** step
  (`dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:1168-1173`), and the loop and the Agent object
  share one `options` reference (`:774`, `:1739`).

The order matters in the other direction too: the child's initial prompt is
submitted *after* creation and the loop appends it to the transcript only
*inside* that first step, so the teammate name must be read from the step's
claimed messages (`payload.messages`), with the transcript as a fallback for a
resumed teammate. Reading the session snapshot at `agent/created` time finds
nothing — that was the first implementation's fatal flaw.

## Tools

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `spawn_teammate_routed` | Same contract as `spawn_teammate`, plus `provider` / `model` / `reasoning_effort`. Omit all three to inherit the Lead route. |
| `list_teammate_models` | Lists selectable providers, then selectable models for one provider, then that model's reasoning efforts. |

Both are installed in the **Lead's own Agent scope** (never globally), so
teammates do not see them.

## Allowlist

When `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent/model-selection-settings` is
`enabled: true`, explicit routes outside `allowedModels` are rejected **before**
the teammate is created. Pure inheritance is never restricted. An enabled but
empty allowlist makes every route unselectable rather than failing inheritance.

The route is also validated through `llm.resolveCallConfig()`, so an unknown
model or an unsupported reasoning effort fails with the adapter's own message
instead of surfacing later as a failed turn.

## Config

```yaml
- id: team-model-routing
  name: 'dsh-plugin-team-model-routing'
  config:
    toolName: spawn_teammate_routed
    listToolName: list_teammate_models
    freshProvider: spawn
    forkProvider: fork
    routeTtlMs: 120000
```

`freshProvider` / `forkProvider` are the provider names handed to the shipped
Team service; they must name registered subagent providers (`spawn`, `fork`).

## Known limits

- **The route is process-local.** It lives in the plugin's memory, so it applies
  while the child is created in this process. A teammate cold-resumed after a
  Harness **restart** falls back to the `agentOptions` recorded in its
  `subagent/descriptor`. Making that survive a restart needs a durable record and
  is the natural follow-up.
- **`agent.options` is a runtime object**, not part of the public `Agent`
  interface. The rewrite is the reason this stays a plugin rather than a
  one-line change; upstream, the clean fix is to let the provider contribute
  `agentOptions` through `ContinuableCreateSpec` (or to accept `agentOptions` on
  the team spawn request). The upstream repository does not accept external PRs
  — publish this as a `dsh-plugin`, and raise the API gap in Discussions.
- A recorded route that is never claimed (a spawn that failed before the child
  existed) expires after `routeTtlMs` and is harmless.

## Test

```sh
node packages/team-model-routing/test/logic.test.mjs
```

18 checks over route validation, allowlist enforcement, discovery rendering, the
claim store, and teammate-name extraction. It covers `logic.js` only — the
`agent/pre-step` seam itself needs a live run.

## Install

Published as [`dsh-plugin-team-model-routing`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-team-model-routing)
on npm, source at [Lingrui98/dsh-plugin-team-model-routing](https://github.com/Lingrui98/dsh-plugin-team-model-routing).

```sh
npm install dsh-plugin-team-model-routing
```

or point the plugin manager at the installed package or a workspace directory:

```js
plugin_manager({ action: 'install_bundle', target: 'dsh-plugin-team-model-routing' })
```

Installing loads the module once; because Node caches ES modules by resolved
path, **replacing this package's code requires a Harness restart** to take
effect in a running process.

## Repository layout

```
index.js            Cordis Host plugin: tools, routing hook, Provider wiring
logic.js            dependency-free routing/claim logic (unit-tested)
cordis.patch.yml    Loader patch: this row + the tool-agent-team config
locale/{en,zh}.json Plugin Manager display metadata
test/logic.test.mjs the 18-check logic suite (not shipped in the npm tarball)
```

`npm pack` ships `index.js`, `logic.js`, `cordis.patch.yml`, `icon.svg`,
`locale/*.json`, `LICENSE`, and both READMEs.


## Verified live

Observed on the `desktop` profile, 2026-10-15, with the profile's
`subagentModelSelection` allowlist enabled:

| Check | Evidence |
|---|---|
| Route reaches the child | `spawn_teammate_routed({ provider: 'model-server', model: 'glm-5.3', reasoning_effort: 'high' })` → host log `team-model-routing: teammate "confirm-route" now runs on model-server/glm-5.3 (effort high)`, and `list_agents` reported that teammate as `model: "glm-5.3"` while the Lead was `gpt-6.1-sol` and the profile default is `bosc/deepseek-flash`. |
| `list_agents` reads the applied route | `list_agents` shows the rewritten `model` for the routed teammate, and `gpt-6.1-sol` (the inherited route) for teammates created before this plugin existed. |
| Allowlist rejects before creation | `spawn_teammate_routed({ provider: 'bosc', model: 'gpt-5.6-luna' })` → `Error: teammate LLM route "bosc/gpt-5.6-luna" is not allowed by the Subagent model-selection allowlist; allowed: model-server/glm-5.3, kimi-code/k3, bosc/gpt-5.6-sol, model-server/kimi-k3, bosc/deepseek-flash` — no teammate was created. |
| Both tools are live in the Lead scope | `Tool.listTools` lists `spawn_teammate_routed` (with `provider`/`model`/`reasoning_effort`) and `list_teammate_models`. |

Not covered by the live run: the `fork` context, and route survival across a
teammate cold-resume (see Known limits).

## Releasing a new version

The package is `dsh-plugin` shaped: `dsh.bundle.patch` points at
`cordis.patch.yml`, the manifest carries display `meta`, `icon.svg`, `locale/{en,zh}.json`,
and it is `type: module`. To release:

1. Bump `version` in `package.json` (npm rejects a re-publish of an existing version).
2. `node test/logic.test.mjs` — 18 checks must pass.
3. `npm pack --dry-run` — confirm the tarball is the 10 files listed under
   [Repository layout](#repository-layout).
4. `npm publish` — the npm account has 2FA enabled, so pass `--otp=<code>` or use a
   granular token with **bypass 2FA** enabled. When a code is needed, ask for one
   interactively rather than storing it.
5. `git commit` and `git push` the release.
6. If the package name ever changes, update the `name:` line in `cordis.patch.yml`
   to match — the Loader resolves the row by that string.

## Inviting t

plugins.description: A portable memory protocol for AI agents — load it as standing rules; a curation discipline + reference spec + optional cap hook.
plugins.readme_text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

# Engramory

[![CI](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.9%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)

**An opinionated, zero-infrastructure memory *protocol* for small-scale, local,
file-based agent memory** — a strict curation discipline plus a validator
(`tools/engramory_doctor.py`), loaded as **standing rules** (`CLAUDE.md` /
`AGENTS.md` / your host's rules file). It is not a database, a framework, or a
relevance-loaded skill. Memory is a folder of small, human-readable markdown files
plus one always-loaded index. No database, no embeddings, no server — just
plain-text files you can open, read, edit, and diff in any editor (the live store
itself stays git-ignored).

> *Engramory* — coined from *engram* (the physical trace a memory leaves in the
> brain) + *memory*. Here: one file = one fact.

> ⚠️ **Unrelated projects share this name.** *engram + memory* is an obvious
> coinage and at least one other repository arrived at it independently. This
> project is only ever `tinqiao-oss/engramory` (npm: `dsh-engramory`); a same-named
> repo under a different owner is not a fork, a mirror, or a newer version of it.

> 🤖 **Are you an AI agent, asked to install or check this?** Start at
> **[AGENT-SETUP.md](AGENT-SETUP.md)**, not at the install steps below. It is the
> procedure for working out what your host can actually enforce, whether a store
> already exists, what you must not touch, and what to tell the user — the parts
> agents reliably get wrong when improvising.

> **Status: 0.12.1 — experimental.** The hard index cap (a `PreToolUse` hook) is
> deterministic for the matched direct-edit tools (`Edit | Write | MultiEdit`) but
> NOT a global write guard (shell tools — Bash, PowerShell, a background Monitor
> command — plus MCP file tools, external editors, and sync clients bypass it);
> the discipline loads as standing rules the model follows, so it's
> best-effort, not guaranteed on every task (see [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) §8). Assumes a
> single writer / serialized writes. Don't rely on it as a "mandatory, reliable,
> cross-agent" memory layer yet.

---

## What this is — and is NOT

Engramory is **not a new memory architecture**. The "markdown files + a small index
loaded into context + the model curates it" pattern is now the mainstream shape
for agent memory, and it ships in several places already. Engramory stands on:

- **Claude Code native auto-memory** — the same markdown-`MEMORY.md`-index +
  lazy detail-file pattern; its system prompt even uses the same
  `user | feedback | project | reference` type vocabulary (per
  [anthropics/claude-code#58840](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/58840);
  the *public docs* describe only the index + topic files). Engramory is a
  disciplined superset of this default.
- **[basic-memory](https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory)** — markdown
  source-of-truth, YAML frontmatter `type`, `[[wikilink]]` graph, local-first.
- **[obsidian-second-brain](https://github.com/eugeniughelbur/obsidian-second-brain)**,
  **[claude-memory-compiler](https://github.com/coleam00/claude-memory-compiler)**
  ("a loaded index beats vector search at personal scale"), and the broader family
  of markdown-memory skills.

What Engramory contributes is the **opinionated bundle + the discipline**, not the
primitives. Do not claim novelty on markdown, frontmatter, wikilinks, a loaded
index, one-file-per-fact notes, or curation hygiene — all are prior art.

## What's actually differentiated

1. **A role/purpose ontology, headed by `feedback` = procedural memory.** The
   semantic / episodic / **procedural** split is established prior art — the CoALA
   taxonomy, and a named procedural type in LangMem and mem0 — so Engramory does not
   claim the category. What it does is make procedural `feedback` the *spine* of a
   deliberately tiny, hand-authored, human-readable set, with required **Why:** /
   **How to apply:** lines, instead of auto-extracting it into a vector/graph store.
   The contribution is the packaging and discipline, not the ontology.

2. **The curation contract as concrete behaviour** the protocol applies (model-followed, not a hard gate): dedup-before-write,
   update-don't-duplicate, delete-when-wrong, and a negative-scope rule ("don't
   store what git/CLAUDE.md/the code already records"). Surveys consistently name
   *modify/delete/forget* as the most under-implemented memory operation — Engramory
   makes it the spine.

3. **A bounded index designed not to silently rot.** The index loads every session and
   Claude Code reads the first 200 lines / 25 KB (documented behavior), so an unbounded index silently
   drops memories off the end. Engramory warns at 150 lines / 20 KB, compacts-or-asks
   before 200 / 25 KB, and ships a hard `PreToolUse` hook backstop (it blocks only
   *growth* past the cap — shrinking/compaction edits always pass). Both the line and
   byte caps apply — whichever is hit first triggers (an index can be under the line
   count yet over on bytes when the lines run long).

   Claude Code has since followed up on this natively: v2.1.186 (released
   2026-06-22) reminds the agent to compact the index when it nears the cap, and
   v2.1.210 (released 2026-07-14) turned an over-cap write into an explicit error
   instead of a silent truncation. Both are after-the-fact alerts, though — the
   write still lands, and entries past the cap stay invisible until someone
   compacts. Engramory's hook denies the write *before* it happens, so a write
   through the matched edit tools never leaves the index over-cap in the first
   place (writes outside them — a shell, an MCP file tool — are not gated; see the
   status note above and SKILL.md §8). The native alerts validate the direction
   and make a welcome second layer — and older versions and other hosts still
   have neither.

## How it compares

| | storage | recall | human-readable | typed ontology | curation discipline | bounded index | infra |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Engramory** | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ role-based (4) | ✅ contract (model-run) | ✅ 150/200 + hook | none |
| CC auto-memory | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ same 4 types | partial (auto) | ~200-line window* | none (built-in) |
| basic-memory | md + SQLite | semantic/FTS search | ✅ | ✅ freeform type | schema + overwrite checks | ❌ (no loaded index) | SQLite + embeddings |
| obsidian-second-brain | md vault | index-first + search | ✅ | folder-typed | ✅ reconcile/lint | partial | none |
| mem0 / Zep | vector/graph DB | semantic | ❌ (DB) | typed (prefs/episodic/proc.; Zep custom) | auto-extract | n/a | DB + embeddings |
| [agentmemory](https://github.com/rohitg00/agentmemory) | SQLite + vector index (+opt. graph) | hybrid BM25+vector (+opt. graph), RRF | ❌ (DB/engine) | ✅ 4-tier lifecycle (work./epis./sem./proc.) | auto (capture + dedup + decay) | n/a | iii engine (local) + opt. embeddings |

Engramory's lane: **minimalism + actionable role typing + curation discipline, zero
infra.** It does *not* try to out-search basic-memory, out-scale mem0, or
out-capture agentmemory — those solve a different problem (auto-capture /
auto-ingest at volume) at a different cost point. agentmemory is the closest
heavyweight foil: also local-first, but it bets on automatic capture (lifecycle
hooks) + hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vectors + optional graph) on a SQLite/`iii`
engine, where Engramory bets on hand-curation + a tiny always-loaded index and
ships no engine at all.

\* Claude Code's [memory docs](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/memory)
document this exactly: *"the first 200 lines of `MEMORY.md`, or the first 25KB,
whichever comes first, are loaded at the start of every conversation."* Other hosts
vary, so the window stays configurable via the hook's env vars.

## Where it fits — and the goal

Engramory is a **portable memory *discipline*, not a

plugins.description: dsh plugin that syncs pi.dev model listings into the pi-ai catalog and llm-pi-ai settings — new provider models become selectable without hand-editing node_modules.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-pi-ai-sync

A [dsh](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Cordis plugin that keeps
provider routes in step with the pi.dev gateway by maintaining **both** layers a
model has to pass through:

- the **pi-ai catalog** (`@earendil-works/pi-ai/dist/providers/data/<route>.json`)
  — the "does dsh know this model and which protocol does it speak?" layer, and
- the **settings model list** (`llm-pi-ai.providers.<route>.models`) — the
  "does the model picker offer it?" layer.

It is the fusion of
[`dsh-model-sync`](https://github.com/fan56/dsh-model-sync) (settings seam) and
[`dsh-opencode-go-models`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-opencode-go-models)
(pi-ai catalog file), with no hand-maintained protocol/family tables: pi.dev's
listing already carries every record in pi-ai catalog shape.

## Why

dsh resolves a configured model's wire protocol as
`route.api ?? catalog[id].api ?? sharedCatalogApi(route)`. On the dsh 0.1.x line
the settings model schema has **no per-model `api` field**, so:

- routes with a single protocol are fine — the route-level api fills the gap;
- a **mixed-protocol** route (`opencode`: anthropic-messages +
  openai-completions + openai-responses + google-generative-ai) has no shared
  api, so any model missing from the installed catalog is rejected outright:
  hand-adding it errors, and a settings-only sync has to drop it.

`dsh-pi-ai-sync` fixes the root cause instead of working around it: it copies
the missing records into the installed catalog, then lets the (now complete)
catalog serve the route.

## How it works

```
one round, per managed route
  1. GET https://pi.dev/api/models/providers/<route>     (catalog-shaped records)
  2. catalog layer  → copy records the installed catalog is missing into
                       dist/providers/data/<route>.json
                       (atomic write + first-modification backup)
                       ⇒ the model becomes base-matching; restart needed
  3. settings layer → reconcile llm-pi-ai.providers.<route>.models
                       (unset by default; mirror/keep optional)
```

A **layer** is where the data lives (the pi-ai catalog / the `llm-pi-ai`
settings); a round touches both, in that order, for every managed route.

Because the catalog is imported into memory at boot, step 2 only takes effect
after a dsh restart — a round that added models reports `restartNeeded`.

## Install

Not on npm yet — install it from GitHub today:

```bash
# newest `main` (what you want while the plugin is still young)
dsh plugin --profile web add github:jiaruihuang/dsh-pi-ai-sync

# a pinned release
dsh plugin --profile web add github:jiaruihuang/dsh-pi-ai-sync#v0.1.0

# or from a local checkout:
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-pi-ai-sync
```

Restart dsh afterwards (bundle-layer change).

### GitHub installs need the build script allowed

A `github:` install runs the package's `prepare` script (never
`prepublishOnly`), because the TypeScript sources are the only thing in the
repository — `lib/` is gitignored. pnpm blocks install-time scripts by default,
so add the key it prints to the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml`:

```yaml
allowBuilds:
  "dsh-pi-ai-sync@git+https://github.com/jiaruihuang/dsh-pi-ai-sync.git": true
```

Use that form, not a bare `dsh-pi-ai-sync: true` (pnpm cannot match a name to a
git source) and not the commit-pinned `…/tar.gz/<sha>` form pnpm's own error
message suggests — the pinned key goes stale on the next push, the `git+https`
key does not. dshmarket's "allow build scripts and retry" button writes both
forms for you.

Integrity note: the tarball your install resolves to is the tag/commit you
asked for, and the build happens on your machine from those sources. Use
`#vX.Y.Z` when you want a reproducible environment.

### Behind a proxy

This plugin reaches pi.dev with Node's global `fetch`, which **ignores**
`http_proxy` / `https_proxy` unless Node is told to read them. On a network
that only reaches pi.dev through a proxy, a round fails with a bare
`TypeError: fetch failed` — and only sometimes, because the direct route is
usually still there for other hosts. Start dsh with:

```bash
NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 dsh web          # Node >= 24; see: node --help | grep proxy
```

(`--use-env-proxy` is the same switch as a CLI flag.) `NO_PROXY` is honoured
either way. This is a host setting on purpose: reading the environment from
inside the plugin would mean taking on an HTTP-proxy dependency, and this
package has none.

## Configuration

Edit the `pi-ai-sync` section of your settings document (on the dsh 0.1.x line
that is `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`):

```yaml
pi-ai-sync:
  managedRoutes:
    - opencode
    - opencode-go
  settingsMode: unset
  intervalMinutes: 240
```

| Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `managedRoutes` | `[]` | Routes to sync; empty = `opencode`, `opencode-go` |
| `settingsMode` | `unset` | `unset` removes the route's `models` override; `mirror` rewrites it from pi.dev; `keep` leaves settings alone |
| `catalogSync` | `true` | Maintain the installed pi-ai catalog files (the core layer) |
| `updateExistingModels` | `false` | Also refresh records the catalog **already has** with the fields pi.dev states today |
| `intervalMinutes` | `240` | Auto-refresh interval; `0` = startup only |
| `startupDelaySeconds` | `5` | Delay before the first auto round |
| `refreshTimeoutMs` | `120000` | Abort budget for one round's request |
| `fetchAttempts` | `3` | Fetch attempts per route, with exponential backoff; `1` disables retrying |
| `syncNotify` | `true` | Log the report when there was something to report |
| `keepCatalogOnly` | `true` | In `mirror` mode, also write ids that exist only in the catalog |

### Choosing `settingsMode`

`models` **replaces** the served catalog. dsh resolves
`configured.length > 0 ? configured : catalog`, so a non-empty list stops the
catalog's own list from being used at all. That is what makes the three modes
different things:

| Value | What it does to `llm-pi-ai.providers.<route>.models` | Use it when |
|---|---|---|
| `unset` (default) | removes the key; `modelOverrides` is deliberately left alone | you want the enriched catalog to be the single source of truth — the plugin's design |
| `mirror` | writes the full list: pi.dev entries the catalog can back, plus catalog-only ids as bare `{ id }` | you want the list visible and editable in settings (dsh-model-sync's behaviour) |
| `keep` | nothing — the catalog layer only | you manage the list entirely yourself |

Notes worth knowing before you pick:

- `mirror` **rewrites the whole list every round**, so hand-edited fields on it
  do not survive. To hand-tune a model, leave `models` out — see below.
- `mirror` refuses a route with non-empty `modelOverrides`: dsh rejects the two
  together ("models already replaces the served catalog").
- `keep` does **not** mean "the catalog decides". If you leave a non-empty
  `models` list, that list is still what serves the route.
- `keepCatalogOnly` (default `true`) is what holds catalog-only models in the
  mirror list; `false` drops them from the picker.

### Hand-tuning a model without `models`

When a route has **no** `models` key, dsh builds the list from the catalog and
then applies `modelOverrides` per id:

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    opencode:
      apiKeyEnv: OPENCODE_API_KEY
      baseURL: https://opencode.ai/zen/v1
      modelOverrides:
        step-5-preview-free:
          maxTokens: 65536
```

The route then offers every catalog model, with your values layered on. This is
the shape `settingsMode: unset` leaves in place. dsh enforces three rules:
`modelOverrides` may only name ids the installed catalog describes, it cannot
sit beside a non-empty `models`, and its fields are `name`,
`contextWindow`, `maxTokens`, `input`, `reasoningEfforts`, `compat` — no
`api` and no `id` (the id is the dict key).

### Why some ids are "catalog-only"

Two lists move independently:

- the **catalog on disk** — the factory snapshot plus every id past rounds
  merged in, and merges are add-only;
- **pi.dev's live listing** — which gains and drops models over time.

An id the catalog has and pi.dev currently does

plugins.readme_text:
# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-cn-ai-labeling

**AI 生成合成内容标识合规自检** —— 给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 用的 skill 插件。

面向中国大陆市场的 AI 产品，在**设计和发版前**逐条核对生成合成内容标识是否落实。规则来自官方原文，不凭记忆。

## 它能扫出什么（5 条规则）

技能负责「怎么做」，规则引擎负责「有没有做」。同一条命令出证据：

```bash
dsh-ai-labeling --root <项目路径>      # 扫一遍
dsh-ai-labeling --demo                # 看内置演示样本
dsh-ai-labeling --list-rules          # 列出规则与依据
```

| 规则 | 查什么 | 级别 |
|---|---|---|
| `AILABEL-NO-DISCLOSURE` | 生成结果直接回给用户的文件里，没有任何「AI 生成」显式标识 | 高 |
| `AILABEL-MISSING-TEXT` | 全项目找不到一句「AI 生成 / 由 AI 生成 / AI-generated」标识文案 | 高 |
| `AILABEL-NO-REVIEW` | 面向用户输出缺「人工核验 / 仅供参考」提示 | 中 |
| `AILABEL-NO-IMPLICIT-META` | 生成产出文件缺 `generated_by` / `ai_generated` 等隐式标识元数据 | 中 |
| `AILABEL-VAGUE-GENERATED` | 文案写「自动生成 / 系统生成」但无 AI 字样 | 低 |

**每条规则都带 `when` 守卫** —— 不用 AI 的项目上，5 条规则记为「不适用」而不是「通过」，
报告会明写「N 条因不适用本项目未运行」。这一条是防假绿：**不适用 ≠ 没问题。**

**边界**：只做静态检查，报出来是提示确认，不是判定违规；图片/音视频里的隐式标识（数字水印）看不见。

## 依据

| 文件 | 性质 | 施行 | 引用条款 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 《互联网信息服务深度合成管理规定》（第 12 号令） | 部门规章 | 2023-01-10 | 第十六条、第十七条、第十八条 |
| 《人工智能生成合成内容标识办法》（国信办通字〔2025〕2 号） | 规范性文件 | 2025-09-01 | 第三～十二条 |
| **GB 45438—2025**《网络安全技术 人工智能生成合成内容标识方法》 | **强制性国标** | 2025-09-01 | 第 5、6 章；**附录 E（规范性）** |

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-cn-ai-labeling
```

然后重启 dsh。技能会在 agent 需要时自动可用。

## 它帮你回答的问题

- 我这个产品**是不是**义务主体？纯工具方要不要负责？
- 哪些功能**必须**加显式标识，哪些**不必**？
- 文件元数据里的 AIGC 到底该写成什么格式？
- 导出的 Word / 图片里，标识该怎么带？
- 上架应用市场会被问什么？
- **哪些常见的"合规要求"其实是我多虑了？**

## 三个不显然但很关键的判断

**1. 隐式标识的义务面比显式标识宽。**
隐式标识挂在《深度合成规定》第十六条（对使用其服务生成或编辑的信息内容普遍适用）；
显式标识挂在第十七条第一款（仅限可能导致公众混淆或误认的 5 类服务）。
只做图片生成的产品，显式标识要看场景判定，**隐式标识从第十六条起就适用**。

**2. 义务主体是「服务提供者」，不是产品形态。**
纯客户端 / 纯工具（用户自部署、自配模型）不是义务主体 —— 不能给它扣「未标识」的帽子。
但它的**导出链路**是用户唯一无法自行补齐标识的地方，所以仍应提供标识能力。
另外，「通过提供可编程接口等方式」被 GB 45438 3.7 明确写入定义，**套壳调第三方 API 不豁免**。

**3. 详尽但不误伤。**
GB 45438 附录 A/B/C/D/F **都是资料性**（推荐与示例），**只有附录 E 是规范性**。
数字水印是「准许采用」，附录 A.2 明确写「在本文件中不做要求」。
5% 字高只适用于图片 / 视频 / 虚拟场景，文本、音频、交互界面**没有**字号要求。
插件专设一节列出这些边界 —— 误报多了，人就再也不看报告了。

## 覆盖的检查面

| 组 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| **第 0 步** | 义务主体判定（自建服务 / 工具 / 端上模型） |
| **A. 显式标识** | 文本、图片、音频、视频、虚拟场景、交互场景界面 + 下载/复制/导出链路 |
| **B. 隐式标识** | 五要素齐备、附录 E 格式、Label 取值、字符集、一文件一份 |
| **C. 协议与流程** | 用户服务协议、无标识版本与日志留存、禁止删除篡改 |
| **D. 分发与备案** | 应用市场上架问询、算法备案与安全评估材料 |
| **E. 防误伤** | 明确列出不构成强制要求的项及依据 |

## 取证脚本

插件随包分发 `labeling-check.sh`，技能正文里会给出它的**绝对路径**。

```bash
# 扫代码库，收集标识实现的证据与缺口
bash <labeling-check.sh 路径> --code --dir .

# 校验一个真实产出文件的元数据（导出物 / 图片 / 文档）
bash <labeling-check.sh 路径> --meta ./导出样例.docx
bash <labeling-check.sh 路径> --meta ./生成图.png

# 一起跑
bash <labeling-check.sh 路径> --all --dir .
```

**退出码**：`0` = 未发现问题；`1` = 有发现 —— 可直接用在 CI / 发版前卡口。

脚本只做**取证**：报告"找到了什么、缺什么"，是否违规由人判断。`--meta` 会真实解析文件里的 AIGC JSON，校验 7 个要素、`Label` 取值、字符串类型与字符集。

## 设计取舍

**不内置任何形式的"合规结论库"。** 标识规则会随监管更新，插件里固化的判断迟早过期。所有条款号与数值只来自上表官方来源，并在技能正文里附来源链接。

**不联网。** 只扫本地代码与被指定的文件，不把待审内容发往任何第三方服务。

**只读，不改。** 插件不会修改被扫描的项目。

## 与其它插件的关系

与 [`@deepwhale-cn/dsh-cn-compliance`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepwhale-cn/dsh-cn-compliance) 互补：

- `dsh-cn-compliance` —— 发布前扫**对外文案**（广告法极限词、网络工具红线、备案展示）
- `dsh-cn-ai-labeling` —— 开发时查**产品实现**（标识有没有写进代码与导出物）

按 [DSH 插件生态倡议书](https://github.com/anywhere-labs/dsh-desktop/blob/main/docs/plugin-ecosystem.md) 的三条原则开发：**组合优先、声明清晰、兼容优先**。

## 许可

MIT

---

> 本插件是工程辅助工具，不构成法律意见。条款以官方最新文本为准。

---

## 深鲸网安守护系列（共 31 个）

> 一个插件做一件事。**安全问题是链式的** —— 配套用才完整。

**国内合规** ｜ [等保对照](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-mlps) · [日志留存](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-log-retention) · [备案公示](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-filing) · [用户同意](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-consent-guard) · [个人信息权利](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-rights) · [未成年人保护](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-minor-guard) · [影响评估](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-pipia) · [数据分类分级](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-data-classify) · [算法备案](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-algorithm-filing) · [数据出境](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-data-export) · [国密合规](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-crypto) · [**AI 内容标识**](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-cn-ai-labeling)

**AI 与 Agent 治理** ｜ [AI 输出信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-ai-output-trust) · [外部内容信任](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-content-trust) · [MCP 安全](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-mcp-audit) · [Agent 权限](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-scope) · [策略核对](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-agent-policy) · [可疑指令](https://github.com/feely0208/dsh-phishing-guard)

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-host-mcp

DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件：连接装了 [host_server_mcp](https://gitee.com/awol2010ex/host_server_mcp) 的服务器，在 Web 设置页配置（IP/主机名 + 端口 + token），之后 **agent 对话里即可访问这些服务器排查问题**——查看信息、执行脚本、读文件、一键诊断。

## 能力

| 通道 | 能力 |
|------|------|
| **设置 → 插件 → 服务器** | 增删改服务器（host/port/token/mcpPath/备注）、设默认、行内「测试连接」（保存前预检，不依赖已落盘配置） |
| **agent 工具 `host-mcp`** | `probe`（连通诊断）、`diagnose`（一键排查）、`whoami`、`list_files`、`count_file_lines`、`read_file_lines`、`exec_script`、`server_info`（服务端环境）、`health`、`servers`、`version`、`probe_uncached`（配置页预检） |
| **侧边栏「服务器」按钮** | 浮动运维面板：概览 / 文件 / 执行 三个页签 |

## 安装

```bash
# 1. 构建（产出 lib/）
npm install
npm run build

# 2. 装进 web profile
cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/web"     # Windows: C:\Users\<you>\.dsh\profiles\web
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add D:/workspace_node/dsh-hosts

# 3. 重启 dsh
```

装好后 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 会多出一行（插件自带的 bundle patch 也会 insert 同一 id，二者幂等）：

```yaml
- id: host-mcp
  name: dsh-host-mcp
```

## 配置服务器

打开 **设置 → 插件 → 服务器**（在「内置插件」页的页签里）：

1. 点 `+ 添加服务器`，填 **主机/IP**、**端口**、**Token**（host_server_mcp 的 token，形如 `hsk_...`）；
2. 单选钮设为默认服务器；
3. 点 `保存配置` —— 写入 profile 配置（volatile 字段，宿主热更新，无需重启）；
4. 想先验证再保存，点行内 `测试连接`：依次探 `/health` 与 MCP `initialize`，token 是否有效一目了然。

> 也可以用 `高级：JSON 编辑` 直接编辑 `servers` 数组。
> token 会明文写入本机 profile 配置文件，请只填可信的内网服务器。

### 配置字段

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| `servers` | `[]` | JSON 数组 `[{id,host,port,token,mcpPath,note}]` |
| `defaultServer` | 第一个 | 省略 `server` 参数时使用的服务器 |
| `requestTimeoutMs` | `60000` | 单次 MCP 请求 HTTP 超时 |
| `defaultTimeoutSecs` | `10` | `exec_script` 默认超时（服务端会再钳一次） |
| `readLimitBytes` | `131072` | 读文件预览默认字节上限 |
| `maxResultChars` | `262144` | 工具结果回传上限（超出截断） |

## agent 工具

```
host-mcp(action, args?, server?)
```

`action` 取值与用法：

| action | args | 用途 |
|--------|------|------|
| `probe` | — | **连通诊断**：health + MCP initialize + whoami，失败时给修复提示 |
| `diagnose` | — | **一键排查**：health + whoami + 系统探测（uname/负载/内存/磁盘/CPU 进程） |
| `whoami` | — | token 身份、作用域（read/exec）、可访问根目录、限流与超时上限 |
| `list_files` | `{path, pattern, recursive, max_entries}` | 列目录（glob + 递归） |
| `count_file_lines` | `{path}` | 行数/字节数/修改时间（读大文件前先调用） |
| `read_file_lines` | `{path, start_line, end_line, with_line_numbers}` | 按行区间读文件 |
| `exec_script` | `{script, interpreter, cwd, timeout_secs}` | 在服务器沙箱内执行脚本（失败回 `error_kind` 结构化分类，如解释器未授权、命令被拦截等） |
| `server_info` | — | 服务端运行环境：OS/架构、可用解释器及版本、白名单与默认解释器（需 exec 作用域；`exec_script` 前可先调用选解释器） |
| `probe_uncached` | `{host, port, token, mcpPath}` | 探测**尚未保存**的服务器定义（配置页「测试连接」专用；回包只给阶段结论与修复提示，不回显 token） |
| `health` | — | `GET /health` |
| `servers` | — | 已配置服务器清单（**不含 token**） |
| `version` | — | 插件名称与版本 |

对话示例：

> 帮我看看 bd-pr-rn1 上 host_server_mcp 服务是否正常，磁盘还剩多少。

agent 会调 `host-mcp(action:"diagnose", server:"bd-pr-rn1")`，一次拿到服务状态 + 系统信息。

## 架构

```
浏览器半（lib/client.js）
  ├─ 设置页配置编辑器 ──► ctx.configForms.get('host-mcp')  ◄─ 官方配置通道（落盘 + 热更新）
  └─ 侧边栏/浮动运维面板 ──► connection.rpc.call('/api', 'host-mcp/<endpoint>')
                                     │
宿主半（lib/index.js）                  ▼
  ├─ connection.fetch.register('/api/host-mcp/<endpoint>')   ← 精确路由（0.1.5+ 唯一正解）
  ├─ RPC 分发器（rpc.ts）：现读配置 → pickServer → MCP 客户端
  ├─ MCP Streamable HTTP 客户端（mcp-client.ts）：
  │    initialize（拿 Mcp-Session-Id）→ notifications/initialized → tools/call
  │    SSE 帧解析、会话缓存、422/404 会话失效自动重建（服务端空闲回收或重启后自愈）、401 可读报错
  └─ agent 工具（tool.ts）：万能 host-mcp 工具，复用同一条分发路径
```

安全边界：

- token **只**存在于插件配置里；`servers` RPC 端点与工具结果一律脱敏，不回传明文；
- `exec_script` 的最终安全边界在 host_server_mcp 服务端（解释器白名单、危险命令黑名单、强制超时、进程树 kill），本插件不改写、不绕过；
- 浏览器半只能经 `/api` 精确路由访问宿主半，无第二条通路。

## 开发

```bash
npm install
npm run build          # tsc + wrap-client
npm run check          # 冒烟 + 依赖解析 + cordis 服务访问 + 配置解析（离线可跑）
npm run check:resolve  # 只跑依赖解析（从 profile 的 node_modules 出发）
npm run check:cordis   # 真 cordis 验证 ctx.inject 跨 fiber 读服务
npm run check:parse    # 配置解析链路（含 role(secret) 回归）
npm run check:live     # 真机联调（需要 HSM_HOST/HSM_PORT/HSM_TOKEN）
```

真机联调（token 只经环境变量，不落盘）：

```bash
HSM_HOST=bd-pr-rn1 HSM_PORT=8765 HSM_TOKEN=hsk_xxx npm run check:live
```

## 已知限制

- `read_file_lines` 是 host_server_mcp 里唯一返回**原始文本**（非 JSON 信封）的工具，面板已特判；
- MCP 会话有服务端生命周期：rmcp 的 LocalSessionManager 默认空闲 5 分钟即销毁会话（服务重启同理），之后带旧会话 id 的请求会得到 404。客户端会自动「清缓存 → 重新 initialize → 重试一次」自愈，调用方无感——长时间空闲后的第一次调用会多一次握手；
- `diagnose` 的系统探测用 `interpreter: python`（跨平台最稳），需要服务器白名单里有 python；
- 管理 API（`/admin/tokens` 签发/吊销）未接入面板，请用 host_server_mcp 自带的管理接口。

## 许可

Apache-2.0

plugins.description: Per-session extra working directories for DSH: a session-settings option plus a runtime-context reminder that tells the model which extra directories this session may use.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-extra-workspaces

给一个 DSH 会话挂上额外的本地工作目录。清单出现在右侧栏的 **会话设置** 页里，并且会作为一条运行时上下文提醒告诉模型——只在清单变化时注入，不是每轮重复。

## 它做什么

- 会话设置页里多出一节 **额外工作区**：添加目录（走 DSH 自带的目录选择器）、改别名、写一句备注、删除。
- 清单按会话保存（`<DSH_HOME>/storages/session_settings/sessions/<会话id>.json`），DSH 重启后同一条会话仍然带着它。
- 清单变化时，模型的最新上下文里出现一条提醒，列出每个目录的别名、绝对路径、备注，并**如实说明当前权限档下能不能改这些目录**。
- 不注册成 DSH 的正式工作区，不改 DSH 本体的任何文件，不挂 DSH 的任何钩子。

## 权限：说清楚，不假装

本插件**不扩大 DSH 允许写入的范围**。DSH 的可写根只有一个：会话自己的工作目录（外加系统临时目录）。所以：

| 会话权限档 | 主工作区 | 额外工作区 |
|---|---|---|
| 仅可查看 | 读得到，改不了 | 读得到，改不了 |
| 工作区可写 | 读得到，改得了 | 读得到，改不了；只读命令能跑，要写文件的命令会被拒绝 |
| 完全权限 | 完全对等 | 完全对等 |

提醒文本按会话**实际**权限档选措辞，所以模型不会以为自己能写其实写不了。

## 规则

- 同一个目录重复添加会被拒绝；
- 与已有条目互相包含（父目录或子目录）也会被拒绝——避免"加了父目录之后主工作区反而变成它的子目录"这种状态；
- 每个会话最多 8 条（可用 `maxWorkspaces` 配置）；
- 目录被删掉或移走不会自动移除，也**不会**被插件主动标注：提醒里不断言目录是否存在（那需要在每步请求里探测磁盘，会把整个 DSH 卡住），面板上的标注只在目录选择器处于"网页内浏览"形态时可用，且含义是"宿主读不到这个目录"。

## 配置

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `maxWorkspaces` | `8` | 每个会话最多几条（上限 64） |
| `reminderLanguage` | `'zh'` | 提醒文本语言（`'zh'` / `'en'`） |

## 安装

包放进 profile 能解析的位置（例如 `link:D:/projects/dsh-plugins/dsh-extra-workspaces`），把它加进 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`，再按 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的那一行把宿主半边挂上。客户端半边由 `dsh.client` 声明自动装配，无需额外步骤。

## 依赖与升级对照

这个插件依赖 DSH 的哪些特性/API、动了 DSH 的哪些部分、DSH 升级时要复查什么，见 [docs/dsh-dependencies.md](docs/dsh-dependencies.md)。

## 测试

```sh
node --test "tests/**/*.spec.mjs"
```

## 已知边界

- 只支持本地目录；远程（SSH）工作区未支持。
- 不判断目录是否存在：提醒不断言，请求路径上也不探测磁盘（网络路径的探测会同步阻塞整个进程）。
- 会话设置页仍会显示这一项自带的"默认值/已覆盖"框架，那由页面控制，不由本插件控制。

# Whalesong Studio · 鲸歌工坊 — website

The project page of [Whalesong Studio](https://github.com/xuhao1/whalesong-studio) (鲸歌工坊), the long-form fiction plugin for DeepSeek Harness: one static page in two languages, served by GitHub Pages from the root of `main` at <https://whalesong.xuhao1.me> (`CNAME`).

- `index.html` — the page; Chinese and English side by side (`lang="zh"` / `lang="en"`), the language switch keeps the choice in `localStorage`; `?lang=en` or `?lang=zh` picks one.
- `style.css` — light theme, no web fonts, no scripts beyond the language switch.
- `img/` — the cover (drawn with GPT Image through Codex), the icon, `og.jpg` for link previews, the screenshots (`shots/en` is *Alice's Adventures in Wonderland* in the English interface, `shots/zh` is 《红楼梦》 in the Chinese one) and portraits drawn in the Studio (`people/`).

Preview locally: `python3 -m http.server` in this folder, then open <http://localhost:8000>.

The screenshots and pictures come from the plugin's repository (`docs/images/readme/`, and the Studio's own pictures of the two demonstration books). The books are in the public domain.

plugins.description: View and manage DeepSeek Harness agent modes in Web Settings: toggle plugins, edit system prompts, create modes from templates.
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-modes 在 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（dsh）Web 的设置里查看和管理 Agent 模式（预设）：开关每个模式加载的插件、合并内置模式的更新、编辑系统提示词并保留历史版本、用起步模板新建模式。 View and manage DeepSeek Harness agent modes (presets) in Web Settings: toggle the plugins each mode loads, merge built-in updates without losing your changes, edit each mode's system prompt with history, live updates, and an approval-gated chat tool, and create modes from starter templates. The page follows dsh's language setting (Chinese or English). ## 兼容性 | dsh 版本 | 验证方式 | 结果 | |---|---|---| | `0.2.0-rc.2`（npm 当前 latest，也是 Desktop 当前版本） | 安装到 dsh web，在界面里实际操作；用本地假模型抓取实际请求 | 可用；这个版本的 dsh 不提供插件的本地化名称，插件行显示包名和英文说明 | | `0.2.1-alpha.3` | 源码运行，界面操作并用本地假模型抓取实际请求 | 可用 | 插件依赖的 `configEditor`、`agentPresets`、`systemPrompt`、`tools` 等都是 dsh 尚未稳定的接口，其他版本可能需要适配。 ## 功能 设置 → **模式管理**（Modes）页面，按「这个模式能做什么、怎么说话、怎么开始用」组织： **一眼看懂每个模式** - 每个模式一张卡片：名称、描述，以及它能做的事（运行命令、读写文件或只读文件、网页、子代理、扩展自身），不用展开就能比较几个模式 - 卡片下方一行状态：已启用插件数、在用的会话数、改过几项、提示词是否即时生效 - 只有一个主按钮「用它新建会话」；设为默认、复制、查看配置（YAML）、编辑信息、恢复内置、删除都收在「⋯」菜单里 - 需要你处理的事只显示最要紧的一条：插件加载失败、内置模式有更新、身份行被关闭、有未保存的提示词草稿，各带一个处理按钮 - 每次操作的结果（已保存、已同步、出错原因）都显示在页面底部的提示条里，带上模式名称；不管你滚动到哪里都看得到，出错的提示会一直保留到你关闭 - 删除、恢复内置等确认都在原位展开，「取消」在左、操作在右，焦点先落在「取消」；在表单、菜单和确认里按 Esc 只关闭它们自己，不会关掉整个设置窗口；菜单和标签页都可以用方向键操作 **能力：用开关决定它能做什么** - 展开卡片后默认是「能力」页：15 项能力分成「能做的事」「工作方式」「上下文」三组，每项一个开关、一句说明 - 打开一项能力会把它恢复成内置模式里的样子：按运行环境自动开关的插件（例如 Bash 和 PowerShell）恢复成「自动」，内置模式本来就关着的插件（例如 Codex 子代理）保持关闭；关闭则关掉这项能力包含的所有插件 - 「文件」下面可以单独关掉「允许修改文件」，让模式只能读和搜索 - 只开了一部分插件的能力标为「部分开启」 **提示词** - 「提示词」页：编辑开头的系统提示词，点击插入 `{{model}}` 等变量，输入时实时校验变量，可预览完整的系统提示词（包括未保存的修改）；修改过的提示词可以一键恢复内置 - 高级设置：结尾提示词（追加在工具说明、工作区规则之后）、「只用开头这段作为完整的系统提示词」、「附带运行时上下文」。这些和提示词文字一起，点「保存」才生效 - 「在对话中」两个开关立即保存： - 即时生效：保存提示词后，正在运行的会话从下一步起就使用新提示词，不用新开会话 - 允许在对话里修改提示词：模型可以调用 `mode_prompt` 工具读取、替换或追加这个模式的提示词；每次保存都会弹出审批，你批准后才写入 - 历史版本：每次保存（包括在对话里修改、恢复内置）都会记下一个版本，标明来源（设置页、对话中、恢复内置、最初版本、在其他地方修改），最多保留 30 个；任意版本都可以载入到编辑器 - 草稿保护：未保存的修改存在浏览器本地，切换标签、关闭设置或刷新页面都不会丢；可以随时放弃修改；支持导出为 `.md` 文件，或从 `.md` / `.txt` 文件导入 - 保存冲突检测：如果你编辑期间提示词在别处（例如另一个窗口或对话里）被改了，保存会被拒绝并显示最新内容，你可以载入最新内容，或用自己的版本覆盖 **全部插件：需要逐个调整时** - 「全部插件」页列出模式里的每一个插件，有自己的搜索和「只看改动」。插件名称优先用 dsh 提供的本地化名称，dsh 没有提供时（例如 0.2.0-rc.2）用各插件官方的中文名称和说明；行 id、模块路径等技术信息收在「详情」里 - 按运行环境自动开关的插件可以选「自动」「开」「关」；固定后标为「已固定，不再自动切换」，随时可以改回自动 - 修改过的插件标为「已修改」，可以单独还原；整个模式也可以一键恢复内置配置 - 关闭身份（persona）行之前会二次确认 **跟上 dsh 的更新** - 同步内置更新：dsh 升级后，改过的内置模式和基于内置模式创建的自定义模式会提示「内置模式有更新」。同步前会列出新增、移除和有官方更新的插件，以及会保留你的几处修改；确认后合并。你没动过的插件跟随官方，你改过的设置保留你的值，双方都改过的同一项也保留你的值并单独计数 - 之后每次保存修改时也会顺带完成这次合并，并在提示里说明 - 一键修复：模式里有插件加载失败时，整个模式会变成不可用。卡片上会列出失败的插件和原因，一键只关闭这些插件，让模式恢复可用 **新建和删除** - 新建模式时选择起步方式：开发（与标准模式相同）、写作（读写文件、无终端）、聊天（只聊天和搜索网页）、只读调研（能读能搜，不能改文件、不能运行命令），或者复制任意现有模式。每个模板都带一段起步提示词（按界面语言选择中文或英文），并显示会启用多少个插件；名称和 ID 会自动填好。创建后卡片直接展开到「能力」页 - 删除前会统计有多少个打开的会话和已保存的会话在用这个模式（已保存的会话按它实际使用的模式统计），因为删除后再打开这些会话会失败 修改写入当前 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`。没有开启即时生效时，正在运行的会话保持原有配置，之后新建的会话使用新配置。界面支持中文和英文，跟随 dsh 的语言设置。 ## 工作方式 | 文件 | 作用 | |---|---| | `index.js` | 宿主端插件，提供 `POST /api/dsh-modes`，动作包括 `list`、`read`、`toggle`（`force` 可以固定自动开关的行）、`followPlatform`、`applyRows`（能力开关用，一次修改多行）、`resetRow`、`reset`、`sync`、`repair`、`create`（`template` 起步模板或 `from` 复制）、`update`、`remove`、`usage`、`setDefault`、`prompt`、`setPrompt`（`base` 冲突检测）、`history`、`setLive`、`setPromptTool`；并提供 `dshModes` 服务给下面两个模块使用。修改内置模式时，通过 `configEditor.edit()` 在 profile 里写入该模式行的覆盖；插件的显示信息来自 `pluginInventory.list()` | | `rebase.js` | 同步内置更新用的三方合并：以你上次同步时的内置插件列表为基准，把你的修改合并到最新的内置列表上 | | `state.js` | 插件自己的状态文件，放在 profile 目录的 `.dsh-modes/` 下：`state.json` 记录每个模式上次同步时的内置插件列表（自定义模式还记录基于哪个内置模式、用了哪个模板），`history.json` 记录提示词历史 | | `live-persona.js` | 即时生效用的身份行：替换模式里的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona` 行，注册同样的两个提示词分段，但每次组装提示词时读取这个模式最新保存的文字 | | `prompt-tool.js` | `mode_prompt` 工具：作为一行插件放进模式里，所以只有这个模式的会话能看到它；写入前通过 `tools/pre-execute` 要求用户审批 | | `container.js` | 自定义模式容器，配置里保存 `presets` 列表，并对每一项调用 `agentPresets.register()` | | `client.js` | Web 端设置页 | | `cordis.patch.yml` | 插入 `index.js` 和 `container.js` 两个宿主端插件行 | ## 安装 ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-modes ``` 然后启动 `dsh web`，打开 设置 → 模式管理。卸载： ```bash dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-modes ``` 插件做的修改保存在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里，卸载插件不会删除它们：改过的内置模式在卸载后仍按修改后的配置运行。卸载前请注意： - 先在提示词编辑器的「更多设置」里关闭所有模式的「即时生效」和「在对话里修改提示词」。这两项会在模式里放入本插件自己的模块，卸载后这些模式会因为找不到模块而无法使用 - 想完全还原，就把改过的内置模式恢复内置，并删除自己新建的模式 - profile 目录下的 `.dsh-modes/` 文件夹可以一并删除 ## 起步模板 模板都以内置的标准模式为基础，用「允许名单」决定保留哪些插件：名单外的行在创建时一律关闭，这样模板不会开启它没写明的工具。以后同步内置更新时，标准模式新增的插件也会以关闭状态加入，除非允许名单里有它。 | 模板 | 保留的能力 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | 开发 | 与标准模式相同 | 不改动插件和提示词 | | 写作 | 文件读写与搜索、工作区指令、待办、交付文件、技能、上下文压缩、提问、时间 | 没有终端、子代理和网页 | | 聊天 | 网页搜索与读取、上下文压缩、提问、时间 | 不碰文件和终端 | | 只读调研 | 文件读取与搜索、网页、工作区指令、待办、技能、上下文压缩、提问、时间 | 文件工具设为只读（`write: false`、`edit: false`），没有终端 | 在 dsh `0.2.1-alpha.3` 上，我们用本地假模型抓取了实际请求来验证：用「只读调研」模板新建的模式，发给模型的工具只有 `ask_user_question`、`glob`、`grep`、`read`、`read_image`、`skill`、`todo_write`、`web_fetch`、`web_search`、`working_directory`，没有任何写文件、编辑或终端工具；系统提示词也是模板里的那段。 ## 系统提示词 提示词就是该模式身份行（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona`，开启即时生效后是本插件的 `dsh-modes/live-persona`）的配置： - `prefix`（开头）位于系统提示词的最前面，后面还会追加工具说明、工作区规则等内容；`suffix`（结尾）追加在这些内容之后。如果设了 `complete: true`（例如极简模式），开头这段就是完整的系统提示词，结尾和其他内容都不会出现。 - `{{model}}`、`{{provider}}` 这类变量在每一步组装提示词时替换成实际值。可用的变量以当前 dsh 实际注册的为准（例如 `0.2.0-rc.2` 还有 `{{cwd}}`，`0.2.1-alpha.2` 起已移除），编辑器只列出当前可用的变量。DSH 严格校验变量，写错一个会让该模式下的每一步都失败，所以保存前（包括在对话里保存）会检查变量名是否已注册、格式是否完整，校验不过就拒绝保存。 - 预览不需要真的创建会话：它用该模式当前版本的作用域组装提示词，不包含每一步注入的运行时上下文。 - 保存时会带上你开始编辑时的版本；如果服务器上的提示词已经不是那个版本，就返回 `prompt-conflict`，不会覆盖。草稿保存在浏览器的 `localStorage` 里（键名前缀为 `dsh-modes:draft:`），只在当前浏览器有效。 - 即时生效时，dsh 会把新的系统提示词作为一条系统消息追加到会话历史里，而不是改写最开头那段，所以之前缓存的提示词前缀仍然可以命中；新提示词本身仍会多消耗一些输入令牌。这个变化和其他系统提示词变化一样，会记录在会话日志里。 在 dsh `0.2.0-rc.2` 和 `0.2.1-alpha.3` 上，我们都用本地假模型抓取了实际请求，验证了： - 开启即时生效后，保存提示词，同一个正在运行的会话下一步就用上了新提示词； - 模型调用 `mode_prompt` 追加一句话时，界面弹出审批；批准后工具返回「已保存，从下一步起对本会话生效」，下一次请求里就带上了追加的内容，历史版本里也记为「对话中」； - 没有开启即时生效时，保存后新建的会话使用新提示词，已经在运行的会话保持旧提示词。 ## 已知限制 - 同步内置更新依赖上次同步时记下的内置插件列表。用 0.5.0 之前的版本改过的内置模式没有这份记录，第一次同步时无法区分「你改过的插件」和「官方改过的插件」，这些差异都会按你的修改保留；新增和删除的插件不受影响。之后每次保存都会补上记录 - 复制自其他自定义模式的模式，会沿用来源模式的同步基准；来源模式没有记录时（例如用 0.5.0 之前的版本创建），不提供同步 - 即时生效只对开头和结尾这两段文字生效；「完整提示词」「运行时上下文」两个开关仍只对之后新建的会话生效。开关即时生效本身也只对之后新建的会话生效 - `mode_prompt` 只读写开头这段提示词。dsh 的审批策略设为「从不」（例如无人值守运行）时，保存会被拒绝 - 「已保存的会话」统计需要读取每个会话的日志；会话很多时最多统计 8 秒，未统计完会显示「至少 N 个」 - 写操作只依赖 dsh 自带的登录校验，没有额外权限确认 - 提示词草稿只保存在当前浏览器，换浏览器或清除站点数据后会丢失；提示词历史保存在 profile 目录下，换 profile 不会带过去 ## 开发 ```bash npm test ``` 运行同步内置更新所用三方合并的单元测试。 ## 许可证 [MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin — pre-probed OpenCode Go / Zen model routes with availability annotations (region blocks, no credit, client-only free tiers) written into the model name.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-opencode-doctor

[English](README.en.md) | **中文**

**给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）装上「已经实测过可用性」的 OpenCode 模型路由。**

哪些模型真能用、哪些被地区封锁 —— 装完在选择器里一眼看到；被封锁的自动走你本地的代理，额度还能一条命令查出来。

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D20.18-brightgreen.svg)](package.json)
[![GitHub topic](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-blueviolet.svg)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

---

## 0.2.2 更新了什么

| 更新 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 🤝 **官方插件一起装** | `dsh-opencode-go` 成为本插件的依赖并被自动激活 —— 不用再单独装一次，额度胶囊和账号设置页直接可用 |
| 🔌 **代理端口可改** | 新增 `--proxy` 参数和 `OPENCODE_DOCTOR_PROXY` 环境变量，端口不再是硬编码 |
| 🔍 **`check` 会查冲突** | 直接报出「你自己的 patch 会覆盖掉本插件的路由」和「`model-proxy` / `opencode-go` 被重复插入」这类静默问题 |
| 📌 **安装带 tag** | 安装命令固定到版本 tag，不再装浮动的 `main` |

### 0.2.0 有什么

| 更新 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 🌏 **地区限制自动跳过** | 15 个被地区封锁的模型自动走本地代理（默认 `127.0.0.1:7897`），其余模型继续直连，互不影响 |
| 🔑 **网关自包含** | `dsh-model-proxy` 已写成依赖，装插件时自动装上，不用你另外找东西装 |
| 🧹 **标注更干净** | 已经修好的问题不再写在模型名里 —— 「地区限制」这几个字已经消失 |
| ★ **常用模型清单** | 10 个最常用的模型加了 ★，选择器里输入 ★ 直接筛出来 |
| 📊 **额度查询** | 新增 `usage` 命令：已用 / 剩余 / 本周 / 本月，一屏看完 |
| 🐛 **协议分派修复** | 之前模型碰到「地区限制」就停止换协议，会被错误地塞进 OpenAI 路由；现在会继续试到真正能跑的那条 |

## 解决什么问题

网关的 `/models` 接口告诉你它**能提供**什么，不告诉你你**有权用**什么。

地区封锁、余额不足、只限官方客户端的免费层 —— 这些只有真的发一次请求才会暴露。等你选中模型、写好 prompt、按下回车，才发现它根本跑不了。

这个插件把这件事**提前做完**：79 个模型，每一个都真发过一次请求，结论直接写进模型名。

## 效果

DSH 的模型选择器只渲染模型名（不显示描述字段），所以可用性结论就写在名字里：

```
★ Claude Opus 5.5
★ Claude Sonnet 5.5
★ Grok 4.7
★ DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
★ GPT-5.3 Codex
Claude Fable 5（需充值）
Cat Jam Free（限官方客户端）
```

**已经修好的问题不再标注。** 地区封锁的 15 个模型现在由插件自己走代理，名字里干干净净 —— 之前的「（地区限制）」字样不会出现了。

顺带的好处：选择器自带模糊搜索。

- 输入「**★**」→ 只剩常用模型
- 输入「**需充值**」→ 筛出余额不足的那组
- 输入「**限官方客户端**」→ 排除只能官方客户端用的免费层

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:fffcodefox/dsh-opencode-doctor#v0.2.2
```

**tag 一定要带。** 不带 tag 装的是浮动的 `main`，别人拿到的版本无法复现，你以后往 main 推什么都会直接打到所有已安装的人身上。

装完**重启 dsh**，进 **设置 → 模型**，就能看到下面这些新路由。

> **官方插件一起装好了。** `dsh-opencode-go` 写在本插件的 `dependencies` 里，安装时自动带上，并由本插件的 patch 自动激活 —— 你**不需要**再单独装一次，也不需要把它加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`。额度胶囊、账号设置页都跟着一起来。
>
> 不想要它？在自己的 profile patch 里写：
>
> ```yaml
> - id: opencode-go
>   disabled: true
> ```

> **纯配置插件。** 它的全部行为都在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里，不跑任何运行时代码（`lib/index.mjs` 的 `apply` 是空的，只为符合插件规范）。所以它不会影响 DSH 宿主的稳定性，也不会碰你的其它配置。
>
> 唯一的例外是上面那条 `opencode-go`：它会让官方插件在同一个 profile 里跑起来。两个插件可以共存（路由 id 不同），代价是同一个模型在选择器里出现两份 —— 想只留带标注的那份，用官方插件自己的 `modelVisibility` 把它的模型藏掉。

## 地区限制是怎么跳过的

探测发现 15 个模型在中国大陆被封锁（`unsupported_country_region_territory`）。插件不再只是把它们标出来，而是让它们**走代理出去**：

```
你在 DSH 里选 gpt-6-luna
        │
        ├─ 命中代理清单？──是──→ 127.0.0.1:7897 ──→ opencode.ai   ✅
        │                              （探测不到就自动回落直连）
        └──────────────否────────────→ 直连 opencode.ai             ✅
```

- **按模型分流，不做全局代理。** 只有清单里的 15 个模型走代理，其它模型一点不受影响 —— 不会出现「本来能直连的模型被代理带慢」的情况。
- **清单是精确 id，不是通配符。** 避免误伤本来正常的模型。
- **没代理也能用。** `fallbackToDirect` 打开着：代理连不上时，这些模型退回直连，行为和你没装插件时一样。
- **只拦 opencode.ai。** 出口规则限定在这个域名。

### 代理端口不是 7897 怎么改？

默认值 `http://127.0.0.1:7897` 只是 Clash Verge / Mihomo 的常用端口，**不是要求**。三种改法，按省事程度排：

**1. 命令行重写（推荐）** —— 重新生成 patch，端口跟着写进去：

```bash
npx dsh-opencode-doctor render --proxy http://127.0.0.1:7890
```

`probe` 接受同一个参数，重探模型时会一起写进去：

```bash
npx dsh-opencode-doctor probe --proxy http://127.0.0.1:10809
```

不想每次敲参数，就设个环境变量，`render` / `probe` 都会用它：

```bash
OPENCODE_DOCTOR_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:7890 npx dsh-opencode-doctor render
```

当前生效的值不用猜 —— `npx dsh-opencode-doctor check` 第一行就会打出来。

**2. 在 profile patch 里覆盖** —— 适合不想动插件目录的人：

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml
- id: model-proxy
  name: dsh-model-proxy
  config:
    enabled: true
    proxy: "http://127.0.0.1:7890"   # ← 只改这里
    origins:
      - opencode.ai
    models: [ ... 原样抄过来 ... ]
    fallbackToDirect: true
```

DSH 的 patch 是**整体替换** `config` 对象（不是深合并），所以要连 `origins` / `models` 一起抄过去，只改 `proxy` 那一行。

**3. 直接改插件目录里的 `cordis.patch.yml`** —— 能跑，但升级插件会覆盖，不推荐。

**端口写错了会怎样？** 不会崩。`fallbackToDirect: true` 让这些模型回落直连 —— 行为和没装插件一样，只是那 15 个地区受限模型连不上。而且它们名字里**不带**标注（插件认为已经修好了），所以如果你发现它们报错，第一个要查的就是这个端口。

> **只留一条 `model-proxy` 行。** 如果 `dsh-model-proxy` 也被单独列在你 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里，它自带的 patch 会再插一条（默认 7890）—— 两条同 id 的行是**串联**而不是覆盖，请把那个名字从 bundles 列表里删掉。`npx dsh-opencode-doctor check` 会把这种情况直接报出来。作为本插件的依赖，它照样装着、能被解析到。

## ★ 常用模型

选择器里没有「收藏」这个功能，但名字可以模糊搜索 —— 所以把最常用的 10 个模型加了 ★ 前缀，**输入 ★ 就只剩它们**：

`Claude Opus 5.5` · `Claude Sonnet 5.5` · `Claude Haiku 5.5` · `GPT-5.3 Codex` · `Grok 4.7` · `DeepSeek V4.1 Flash` · `GLM-5.3` · `Kimi K3` · `Qwen3.8 Max` · `MiniMax-M3`

同一个模型出现在多条路由上时会**都**带星，所以不管它最后落在哪个协议，都筛得出来。

## 额度查询

不用再登网页翻额度，一条命令：

```bash
npx dsh-opencode-doctor usage
```

```
OpenCode Go 额度  st_96e…c4d9 ← ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml → refs.OPENCODE_API_KEY

  窗口             已用  用掉                   剩余   重置
  滚动窗口 rolling  41%  ████████░░░░░░░░░░░░    59%   10-16 01:18
  本周     weekly   49%  ██████████░░░░░░░░░░    51%   10-19 08:00
  本月     monthly  24%  █████░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░    76%   11-13 23:55
```

- 三个窗口就是官方面板里的滚动窗口 / 本周 / 本月，`剩余 = 100 − 已用`。
- 进度条到 70% 变黄、90% 变红，快用完了一眼就能看出来。
- 加 `--json` 可以接进脚本。
- key 只以 `st_96e…c4d9` 这种打码形式显示，不会完整打印。

## 覆盖范围

路由按**实际能跑通的协议**生成，所以不是每个网关都有三条。下面是发布时的实测结果（探测日期见 `models.catalog.json`）：

| 路由 id | 协议 | 可用 / 总数 | 端点 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `opencode-go-doctor-anthropic` | Anthropic Messages | 2 / 2 | `opencode.ai/inference/go/v1/messages` |
| `opencode-go-doctor-openai` | OpenAI 兼容 | 30 / 31 | `opencode.ai/inference/go/openai/v1` |
| `opencode-go-doctor-responses` | OpenAI Responses | 4 / 4 | `opencode.ai/inference/go/openai/v1` |
| `opencode-zen-doctor-anthropic` | Anthropic Messages | 7 / 8 | `opencode.ai/inference/v1/messages` |
| `opencode-zen-doctor-openai` | OpenAI 兼容 | 11 / 21 | `opencode.ai/inference/v1` |
| `opencode-zen-doctor-responses` | OpenAI Responses | 13 / 13 | `opencode.ai/inference/v1` |

**合计 67 个无标注 / 79 个模型下发**，覆盖 Claude、GPT、Grok、DeepSeek、GLM、Qwen、Kimi、MiniMax 等系列。其中 15 个靠上面的代理才能连上。

同一个模型在不同协议下的可用性并不一致 —— 比如 Zen 的 Claude 只认 Anthropic Messages，`grok-4.7` 只认 Responses，`gpt-6-luna` 只在 Responses + 代理下能跑。`probe` 会逐个协议试，把模型归到它**真正能跑**的那条路由上。

## 标注词汇

| 标注 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| （需充值） | 账户余额不足 |
| （限官方客户端） | 免费层模型，只能在 OpenCode 官方客户端里用 |
| （需授权训练数据） | 需要先授权用你的数据训练 |
| （暂不可用） | 其它失败 |

**没有标注 = 探测时可用。** 地区封锁的模型**不在这里**：它们已经被插件修好（走代理），所以名字里不留字。

> 探测内部仍然会记录「地区限制」这个结论（`models.catalog.json` 里的 `code: region`）—— 它决定了谁进代理清单。只是不再写进模型名。

## 凭证

插件从 `refs.OPENCODE_API_KEY` 读 key，按这个顺序找：

1. 环境变量 `OPENCODE_API_KEY` / `OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY` / `OPENCODE_ZEN_API_KEY`
2. `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`（默认 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`）的 `refs` 块
3. OpenCode 自己的 `auth.json`（`~/.local/share/opencode/`、`$OPENCODE_DATA/`、`%APPDATA%\opencode\`）

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml
refs:
  OPENCODE_API_KEY: st_xxxxxxxx
```

已经装过 `dsh-opencode-go` 的话，key 名是同一个，**不用重复配置**。

**你的 key 不会被写进插件或仓库。** `cordis.patch.yml` 里只有 `apiKeyEnv: OPENCODE_API_KEY` 这个变量名，key 本体在 DSH 启动时从上面这些位置读，请求时放在 `Authorization` 头里发给 opencode.ai —— 和官方客户端做的事一样。

## CLI

装完之后有个 `dsh-opencode-doctor` 命令（`npx dsh-opencode-doctor` 也行）：

```bash
npx dsh-opencode-doctor list      # 看目录里有什么、哪些被标注（离线）
npx dsh-opencode-doctor usage     # 查 Go 套餐额度：已用 / 剩余 / 本周 / 本月
npx dsh-opencode-doctor check     # 凭证、两个网关、以及组合冲突，一次查完
npx dsh-opencode-doctor probe     # 重新探测，重写 catalog + patch
npx dsh-opencode-doctor render    # 只从 catalog 重新生成 patch（离线）
```

`probe` 会对每个模型真发一次请求，结果写回 `models.catalog.json` 和 `cordis.patch.yml`。日常用不着跑 —— 只有网关更新了模型、或你想重新确认一遍时再跑。**重跑 probe 也会自动刷新代理清单**，网关哪天放开某个模型的地区限制，它会自动回到直连。

常用参数：`--gateway <slug>` 只测一个网关、`--concurrency <n>` 并发数、`--timeout <ms>` 单请求超时、`--key <key>` 直接给 key、`--proxy <url>` 出口代理（`probe` / `render` 用）。

`check` 不打网络请求也能干活 —— 它先读本机配置，把**会让插件静默失效的组合**报出来（你自己的 patch 覆盖了 `llm-pi-ai`、`model-proxy` / `opencode-go` 被重复插入），然后才去验证凭证和网关。装完插件先跑一次这个。

## 常见问题

**我没有代理，装了会不会变差？**
不会。代理连不上时清单里的模型自动回落直连（`fallbackToDirect`），表现和你没装插件一样；其它 64 个模型本来就走直连。

**我本来就在用 `dsh-model-proxy`，会打架吗？**
会重复。`dsh-model-proxy` 自己带的 bundle patch 也会插一条 `model-proxy`（默认 `127.0.0.1:7890`，只匹配 `grok-*` / `gpt-*-luna`）。两条同 id 的行**不会互相覆盖**，而是串成两条 dispatcher —— 于是 `grok-*` 会先去敲 7890。把它从 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 列表里删掉即可：它作为本插件的依赖仍然装着、

plugins.description: DSH 插件：向模型暴露 Komari 探针面板工具（列机器、远程执行、上传下载文件），设置页配置面板地址与账号 | DSH plugin exposing Komari monitoring-panel tools (list nodes, remote exec, file transfer) with a settings-page config card
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-plugin-komari DSH 插件（bundle 形式）：把 [Komari](https://github.com/komari-monitor/komari) 探针面板的能力暴露给模型——**列机器**（节点清单 + 实时状态）、**控制机器**（远程执行命令）与**传输文件**（本机 ↔ 目标机），并在 WebUI 设置页配置面板地址与账号。四个工具经 [dsh-plugin-toolsets](https://github.com/huanlinoto/dsh-plugin-toolsets) 注册为一个**按需加载的工具集**。 DSH plugin (bundle): exposes a Komari monitoring panel to the model — list machines with live status, run shell commands on them, and move files between this machine and them — configured from the WebUI settings page. Tools ship as one lazily-loaded toolset through dsh-plugin-toolsets. ## 工具集（按需加载） 四个工具注册为名为 `komari` 的 toolset：平常只占一行目录（名称 + 「什么时候该用」摘要 + 工具数），模型判断需要时调用全局 `get_tools({"toolset":"komari"})` 把整组工具加载进当前 agent，**下一轮**起可用。 - 依赖 `@huanlin/dsh-plugin-toolsets`（peer，需已安装，否则本插件的 `inject: ['toolsets']` 不满足、不会加载）。 - 目录行内容即 [src/tools.ts](src/tools.ts) 里的 `TOOLSET_DESCRIPTION`。 - 子 agent 不继承：子 agent 需自行调用 `get_tools`。 ## 工具 | 工具 | 作用 | |------|------| | `komari_list_nodes` | 列出面板上的机器及其实时状态（在线、CPU%、负载、内存/磁盘/Swap、网络总量、运行时长、连接数、温度、系统、备注）。参数：`group`（分组精确过滤）、`include_offline`（默认 true）。 | | `komari_exec` | 在一台或多台机器上执行 shell 命令，返回每台的输出与 exit code。参数：`command`、`nodes`（uuid / 精确名称 / 唯一名称子串）、`wait_seconds`（默认 30，最大 300）。 | | `komari_upload_file` | 把**本机**（运行 dsh 的机器）的文件传到一台或多台机器。参数：`local_path`、`remote_path`、`nodes`。走面板分片上传协议，单文件上限 8 GiB。 | | `komari_download_file` | 把某台机器上的文件取回**本机**（流式写盘）。参数：`remote_path`、`node`、`local_path`（缺省写系统临时目录下的 `komari-downloads/`）。目录不可下载。 | `komari_upload_file` 会**覆盖目标路径上已存在的文件**，同样需要先确认。 `komari_exec` 是**危险工具**：命令经面板 agent 在目标机上以其自身权限执行（多数 Linux 节点即 root，Windows 节点为 agent 服务账户，走 PowerShell）。工具描述已要求模型在执行重启/删除/改配置/批量命令前先说明计划并取得用户明确同意；面板侧也会记录 `REC, task id: ...` 审计日志。 ## 设置页配置 「设置 → 插件」中找到 `@huanlin/dsh-plugin-komari` 这一行，展开其配置卡： | 字段 | 说明 | |------|------| | 面板地址 | 如 `https://status.example.com`；粘贴 `/api` 或 `/api/v1` 后缀会被自动去掉，无协议时默认补 `https://`。 | | 用户名 / 密码 | 面板账号，**必须是管理员**（远程执行是 admin 权限）。开启 2FA 的账号无法用于本插件（登录接口需要动态 TOTP 码）。 | | 请求超时 (ms) | 单次面板 HTTP 请求超时，默认 15000。 | 改完点「保存」即时生效（工具每次调用都读取最新配置，无需重启）；点「测试连接」会用当前已保存的配置做一次登录 + 拉取节点，验证地址与账号是否可用。 凭据以明文写入当前 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中该 entry 的 `config` 下——请自行确认该文件的权限。 ## 文件传输备注 - 上传走面板的四步协议：`operation=init`（拿 `upload_id`/分片大小）→ 逐个 `operation=chunk`（原始字节，`Content-Length` 必须等于该分片期望长度）→ `operation=merge`（提交）；任一步失败会自动 `operation=cancel` 清掉半成品。 - 面板限制：单文件 ≤ 8 GiB，分片 1 MiB–128 MiB（默认 25 MiB），上传会话 15 分钟过期，最多 4 个并发上传（因此多机上传是串行执行的）。 - 下载是 `GET .../file/download?path=<绝对路径>` 的二进制流，插件边收边写盘；总时长受「传输超时」约束。 - 路径风格随目标机：Linux 用 `/tmp/...`，Windows agent 用 `C:\Windows\Temp\...`（面板会把它规范化成 `/C/Windows/Temp`）。 ## 数据可见性与安全 - 插件以面板**管理员会话**访问 `/api/admin/*`。`GET /api/admin/client/list` 的原始响应里含每台机器的 **Agent Token**，插件在进入模型之前用显式白名单投影（`pickNode`/`pickLive`），只保留状态字段；单元测试 `tests/komari.spec.ts` 钉死了这一行为。 - 会话 Cookie 只保存在宿主进程内存中；遇到 401/403 会清掉旧会话、重新登录并重试一次。 - 密码不写入日志、不回显在工具结果里。 ## 开发 ```sh pnpm install pnpm run build # tsdown: lib/index.js (host) + lib/client.js (browser half, __ModuleLoader__ 包裹) ``` 结构： | 路径 | 职责 | |------|------| | `src/index.ts` | 入口：`name` / `inject` / `Config`（全部字段 `.volatile()`）/ `apply` | | `src/komari.ts` | `KomariClient`：登录、Cookie 会话、`/api/rpc2`、`/api/admin/*`、字段白名单投影 | | `src/tools.ts` | 四个 `defineTool` 定义、`buildKomariToolset()` 与 `registerTools()`（注册到 `ctx.toolsets`） | | `src/transfer.ts` | 本地文件 IO：分片读取上传、流式写盘下载、默认落地路径 | | `src/summary.ts` | 纯函数：节点摘要、引用解析、文本渲染（无 `@deepseek-ai/*` 依赖，便于单测） | | `src/rpc.ts` | 宿主 RPC：`komari.probe`（设置卡「测试连接」） | | `src/client/*` | 浏览器半：`plugins.row.config` 配置卡（row key `@huanlin/dsh-plugin-komari#dsh-komari`） | | `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle 配置层：insert 一行 `dsh-komari`，`config` 是首次启动的种子值 | 约束：`lib/` 预构建入库（含 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-* ` peer，git 安装时无 `prepare`）；不改 DSH 源码。 ## 运行 ```sh # 本地开发（改源码后重新 pnpm run build 即可生效，无需重装） dsh plugin --profile web add "link:D:/Projects/deepseek-harness/dsh-plugin-komari" # 从远端安装 dsh plugin --profile web add "github:huanlinoto/dsh-plugin-komari" ``` 装好后**重启 `dsh web` 进程**，浏览器硬刷新（`Ctrl+Shift+R`），再到「设置 → 插件」填上面四个字段。 ## 检查 ```sh pnpm run typecheck # tsc --noEmit pnpm test # 40 个单测（mock fetch；含 token 不泄漏回归、分片协议回归、toolset 契约） pnpm vitest run tests/e2e.komari.spec.ts # 真实面板 e2e（未设置环境变量时自跳过） ``` 真实面板 e2e 需要： ```powershell $env:KOMARI_E2E_ENDPOINT='https://status.example.com' $env:KOMARI_E2E_USERNAME='admin' $env:KOMARI_E2E_PASSWORD='...' ``` 它覆盖四条链路：登录 + 列机器、读实时状态、在**一台在线机器**上执行 `echo dsh-komari-e2e`、以及**文件往返**（上传一个小文本文件到在线机器的临时目录 → stat 校验 → 下载回来比对内容 → 删除远端文件）。只跑无害命令与临时文件。 ## 已知限制 - 面板账号开启 2FA 时无法使用：登录与 `admin:exec` 都需要动态 TOTP 码。需要这种场景时应改用面板 API Key 认证（当前未实现）。 - 只覆盖「看机器 + 控制机器 + 传文件」：节点增删改、Ping 任务管理等面板管理写入接口未暴露。 - 强依赖 `@huanlin/dsh-plugin-toolsets`：未安装时本插件因 `inject` 不满足而整体不加载（工具不可见）。

plugins.description: Session cost and remaining provider balance below the DeepSeek Harness Web composer.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-cost-meter

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows one ambient line below the Web composer:
the estimated model cost of the current session **and of every subagent session
it started**, plus the remaining balance of the provider route in use.

```
[ Composer card                                 ]
      Cost $0.1306 · Balance $12.50
```

Hovering a pill shows its breakdown: token buckets per model route, how much of
the total came from subagent sessions, per-request fees, and topped-up versus
granted credit for the balance.

## What the number includes

- **This session**, priced from the usage the provider reported in its own log.
- **Every subagent session it delegated to**, transitively. A subagent runs as a
  separate Session with its own log, so the parent's log names its children
  (`subagent/catalog`) but never their usage; the plugin reads each child's own
  projected cost instead — from the live Session while the app still holds it,
  from the child's durable checkpoint once it has settled, and by re-folding that
  child's own log where no checkpoint can serve it (see below).
- **Per-request fees** for calls that are billed outside token usage, currently
  DeepSeek Search/Fetch requests at $0.75 per 1,000 successful requests. A
  request event records the request, not its usage, so this is a stated estimate.

If a child session cannot be read at all — no live Session and no checkpoint
whose lifecycle matches — the plugin does not pretend it cost nothing. It marks
the total as a lower bound (`at least $0.1306`) and says how many sessions were
unreadable, rather than showing a number that looks exact.

Why a total can still differ from <https://platform.deepseek.com>'s usage log:
that page bills an account, so it also covers sessions this machine never ran and
any other client using the same key. Auxiliary model calls whose usage is never
recorded (session titles, and the DeepSeek-side search calls a search request can
fan out to, up to `maxUses` per request) are billed by DeepSeek but are invisible
to any log-based reader. The plugin therefore estimates from what the logs
record, and labels that estimate as one.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness with the Web app (`dsh web`). The balance read needs the
  `connection` and `credentials` services, which the shipped Web composition
  provides.
- For the balance pill, a wallet endpoint plus a stored credential for it; the
  built-in default is DeepSeek's Platform balance endpoint with a
  `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` credential reference. Cost needs nothing: prices ship in the
  row config.

## Install

```sh
# 1. install the package into a profile
dsh plugin --profile web add github:dsh-plugin-db/dsh-cost-meter

# …or from a local checkout
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-cost-meter
```

2. Enable the bundle: **Settings → Plugins → Installed → dsh-cost-meter → on**.
   (An agent driving the plugin manager does both steps at once with
   `install_bundle`.)

The package ships a bundle patch, so enabling it inserts the row with built-in
defaults. Cost works immediately; the balance pill appears once a wallet source
answers. The credential reference is resolved on the Host, so the secret never
reaches the browser.

## Configuration

Every value lives in the row config, so it survives DSH upgrades in the
profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` (highest-priority layer):

```yaml
- id: dsh-cost-meter
  name: 'dsh-cost-meter'
  config:
    prices:
      - provider: '*'        # '*' matches any route; a literal provider wins over '*'
        model: deepseek-flash
        currency: USD
        input: 0.3           # per 1M cache-miss input tokens
        output: 1.2          # per 1M output tokens
        cacheRead: 0.006     # per 1M cache-hit input tokens
        cacheWrite: 0.3      # optional; defaults to `input`
        offPeak:             # optional; used outside `peakWindows`
          input: 0.15
          output: 0.6
          cacheRead: 0.003
          cacheWrite: 0.15
    peakWindows:             # optional; defaults to DeepSeek's published windows
      - { startHourUtc: 1, endHourUtc: 4, weekdaysOnly: true }
      - { startHourUtc: 6, endHourUtc: 10, weekdaysOnly: true }
    balances:                # optional; provider route → wallet endpoint
      - provider: deepseek-official
        url: https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance
        credential: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY   # credential reference resolved in the Host
        auth: bearer                   # or x-api-key
        timeoutMs: 10000
    fees:                    # optional; Session events that are billed per request
      - event: web/deepseek-search-llm-request
        label: Search
        per1kRequests: 0.75  # DeepSeek Search/Fetch list price, USD
        currency: USD
```

Lookup specificity is `provider+model` → `provider+*` → `*+model` → `*+*`. A
route with no matching row still shows its token count, and the cost pill is
prefixed with "at least" while unpriced calls exist, so an estimate never
pretends to be complete.

A `fees` row counts the Session events of that exact type and bills them per
1,000 requests, outside token pricing, which is how DeepSeek bills its Search and
Fetch calls. The default row covers `web/deepseek-search-llm-request`, the event
the Web app's DeepSeek search feature records for each search request. Set
`fees: []` to price tokens only.

Shipped defaults are DeepSeek's published list prices for `deepseek-flash` and
`deepseek-v4-pro` (per 1M tokens, USD) with their peak/off-peak windows, and the
Search/Fetch per-request fee. Prices change; edit them in the profile patch.

## Balance

The Client reads the balance in two steps, and reports what it finds:

1. The signed-in DeepSeek account through `ctx.remote.account.getBalance`, for
   routes whose provider starts with `deepseek`.
2. This plugin's Host route, asked for the exact route the session is spending
   on. The Host matches that provider against `balances` (an exact provider wins
   over `*`), resolves the named credential through `ctx.credentials`, calls the
   endpoint, and answers with the wallet amounts only.

A route the Host prices no wallet for (`unsupported-provider`) shows nothing, so
the pill never appears for a provider that simply has no `balances` row. Every
other outcome is visible: the amount when the wallets are read, and `Balance —`
with the reason in its tooltip when the credential is missing, the endpoint
fails, or the route does not answer at all. That reason carries the HTTP status
and the body, which separates the two silent failures: a browser sees
`404 not found` when this build's route is not mounted, and `401 unauthorized`
when the request never reached it.

The key never reaches the browser, and the endpoint is ordinary configuration:
another provider whose API returns a wallet needs a new `balances` row plus a
parser kind in `index.js`. Amounts are re-read once a minute; each pill carries
its own currency, so a USD cost and a CNY balance never get conflated.

## How it is built

| Half | File | Role |
|---|---|---|
| Host | `index.js` | Two `sessionProjections` units — `costMeter` (prices provider-reported usage and per-request fees) and `costMeterFamily` (this session plus every session it delegated to) — plus one balance route on Connection's `/api` channel |
| Client | `client.js` | One `conversation.composer.dock` entry that renders the family wire value, falling back to the session value, asking the Host for a family read while the projection is still incomplete, and reading the balance |

The Host folds the durable Session log and publishes two client-visible
projections; the Client renders them through the `useProjection` slot prop. Both
halves were written against documented seams only:

- `ctx.sessionProjections.register({key, stateVersion, stateSchema, init, apply, wire})` —
  projection units; the registry calls only `schema.parse`, so the schemas here
  are small hand-written normalizers with no schema-library dependency.
- The `SessionEvent` envelope and payloads: `request/header` (route),
  `assistant/message` / `assistant/attempt` (usage, from `data.usage` or the
  last `usage` chunk of the com

plugins.description: Cross-session artifact center for DeepSeek Harness: agent tools register deliverable files (PDF/Excel/PPT/code/JSON) into one shared folder, plus a sidebar panel that filters them by category, extension or keyword.
plugins.readme_text:
# 产物中心 · Artifact Center

> DeepSeek Harness（DSH / Cordis）插件：**agent 每次产出重要文件都会登记进一个跨会话的产物中心**，
> 左侧边栏提供面板，按分类 / 后缀 / 关键词即时筛选。

每个对话都在产出文件——报告 PDF、Excel 数据表、PPT、脚本、JSON——但它们散落在各会话的工作目录里，换个对话就找不到了。
本插件把「值得留下的产物」集中到一处：

- **agent 侧**：4 个工具。产出文件时调用 `artifact_save` 登记，默认**复制一份**到统一目录，原目录被清理也不丢。
- **用户侧**：左侧边栏「产物中心」面板。分类 chip + 后缀 chip + 关键词搜索，可复制路径、在文件夹中显示、删除。
- **跨会话**：索引与副本都在 `~/.dsh/artifact-center/`，所有对话共用同一份。

```
┌ 左侧边栏 ────────┐
│ 对话             │
│ 自动化任务       │
│ 产物中心   ← 面板行 │──┐
│ 插件管理         │  │
└──────────────────┘  │
                      ▼
┌ 产物中心 ───────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 分类  [全部] [pdf 3] [excel 2] [code 5] …     刷新│
│ 后缀  [.pdf 3] [.xlsx 2] [.py 4] [.json 1]      │
│ 搜索标题 / 文件名 / 路径 / 备注 / 标签            │
│ ─────────────────────────────────────────────── │
│ 季度报告.pdf      PDF  2.0 MB  复制路径 显示 删除 │
│ train.py          代码 4.1 KB  …                │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## 安装

```sh
# 从 GitHub 安装（推荐）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:lishuo4096/artifact-center

# 本地开发：link 到源码目录
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/path/to/artifact-center
```

也可以在插件市场（dshmarket）里搜索 `artifact-center` 一键安装。

装完**重启 DSH**（宿主的插件模块走 ESM 缓存，改完源码或新装插件都需要重启才加载新代码）；
重启后左侧边栏出现「产物中心」，对 agent 说话时 `artifact_save` 等工具即可用。

## agent 工具

| 工具 | 参数 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `artifact_save` | `path`（必填）、`title`、`note`、`tags[]`、`mode`（`copy` 默认 / `link`） | 登记一个产物。`copy` 会把文件复制进统一目录；`link` 只记路径不动文件 |
| `artifact_list` | `ext`、`category`、`keyword` | 列出/筛选产物，三个过滤条件可组合 |
| `artifact_stats` | — | 按分类、按后缀的计数 |
| `artifact_remove` | `id`（必填） | 删除条目。`copy` 产物连副本一起删；`link` 产物只删条目，**永不碰原文件** |

工具的返回值是结构化 JSON；`artifact_save` 的 `path` 不存在或不是文件时返回 `{ok:false,message}`，不会抛异常打断对话。

## 面板

左侧边栏「产物中心」，与工具读写同一份索引：

- **分类 chip**：`pdf` / `excel` / `ppt` / `word` / `image` / `code` / `data` / `archive` / `other`，带计数，计数为 0 且未选中的不显示。
- **后缀 chip**：按真实后缀分组（`.pdf`、`.py`、`.json`…），按数量降序。
- **搜索框**：服务端匹配标题、文件名、路径、备注、标签（输入 220ms 防抖）。
- **每行操作**：复制路径 · 在文件夹中显示（Windows `explorer /select`、macOS `open`、Linux `xdg-open`）· 删除（二次确认）。

## 数据与配置

```
~/.dsh/artifact-center/
├── index.json   # 索引：id / 原标题 / 原路径 / 存储路径 / mode / 分类 / 后缀 / 大小 / 备注 / 标签 / 所属会话 / 时间
└── files/       # copy 模式的副本
```

索引写入是串行队列（不会两个 tool 调用互相覆盖）。默认根目录是 `~/.dsh/artifact-center`，
可用插件配置 `rootDir` 覆盖：

```yaml
# cordis.patch.yml（用户覆盖层）
- id: artifact-center
  config:
    rootDir: D:/artifacts
```

## HTTP 路由（面板的数据通道）

面板通过宿主 `webServer` 的同源路由取数据，不需要额外服务：

| 路由 | 方法 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/artifact-center/api/state` | GET | `?ext=&category=&keyword=` → `{ok, items, stats, rootDir, categories}` |
| `/artifact-center/api/remove` | POST | `{id}` → 删除条目 |
| `/artifact-center/api/reveal` | POST | `{id}` → 在文件管理器里定位；只接受索引里的 id，路径由服务端解析 |

三条路由都带**同源栅栏**：带跨站 `Origin` 的请求直接 403；写操作必须 `content-type: application/json`
（跨站表单这类「简单请求」不触发预检，声明 JSON 则会预检，而预检打到本路由必然 405/415）；
非浏览器调用（curl / node，没有 Origin）照常可用。`reveal` 不接受任意路径参数，所以无法被用来打开任意文件。

没有 `webServer` 的形态（纯 CLI）下，面板这段不激活，4 个工具照常工作。

## 目录结构

```
artifact-center/
├── package.json          # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client（web）
├── cordis.patch.yml      # 注册进 profile 的 patch 行
├── index.js              # 宿主半边：4 个工具 + 3 条同源路由
├── client.js             # 浏览器半边：侧边栏面板行 + 面板页（window.__ModuleLoader__ 形态）
├── lib/
│   ├── defineTool.js     # 作者侧工具 DSL → 宿主 JSON Schema（零依赖，必须带）
│   └── store.js          # 索引与副本的存储层（串行写、分类规则）
└── test/
    └── local-smoke.mjs   # 离线自检：81 项断言，不需要 DSH 就能跑
```

`lib/defineTool.js` 不是可选的装饰：宿主真正加载的是 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 的 `defineTool`，
但在 profile 里以 `link:` 安装的插件**不能 import 任何 `@deepseek-ai/*`**（它们只在 app.asar 内，Node 解析不到），
所以插件必须自带一份等价实现。作者的 `parameters` 用 `required: true` 这种 DSL 写法，`output.schema: {type:'json'}` 表示无约束 JSON。

## 开发与自检

```sh
node test/local-smoke.mjs
```

零依赖，不需要启动 DSH：伪造 `ctx` / `req` / `res` 后覆盖工具行为（复制落盘、link 不复制、删除 link 不动原文件、
筛选与统计）、三条路由（含同源/方法/content-type 栅栏）、`client.js` 的装载与渲染（用 stub React 渲染空态、
有数据、筛选无命中、错误态），以及**工具 schema 必须通过宿主 `assertSupportedJsonSchema`** 这条回归护栏
（作者侧 `type:'json'` 若被原样透传，宿主 `register()` 会同步抛错，进而中断整个 `apply()`——本插件踩过这个坑）。

## 兼容性

- 面板需要 Web GUI（宿主 `webServer` 同源路由 + `sidebar.panellist` / `main` 插槽）。
- 纯 CLI 形态下工具可用，面板不显示。
- 已在本机 DSH 桌面版（Electron，Web GUI `http://127.0.0.1:19387`）上实测：面板渲染、筛选、删除、
  在文件夹中显示，以及 4 个工具均正常。

## License

MIT

# Artifact Center (English)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH / Cordis) plugin that gives every conversation a **shared artifact center**.

Agents produce files all the time — reports, spreadsheets, slides, scripts, JSON — and they end up scattered across
per-session working directories, effectively lost the moment the conversation changes. This plugin registers the
artifacts worth keeping, in one place:

- **Agent tools** — `artifact_save` (copies the file into a shared directory by default, or just records the path with
  `mode:"link"`), `artifact_list` (filter by `ext` / `category` / `keyword`), `artifact_stats`, `artifact_remove`.
- **Sidebar panel** — category chips with counts, extension chips with counts, keyword search, copy path,
  reveal in file manager, delete with confirmation.
- **Cross-session** — index and copies live in `~/.dsh/artifact-center/`, shared by every conversation.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:lishuo4096/artifact-center
```

Restart DSH afterwards. The panel talks to the host over three same-origin routes under `/artifact-center/api/`
(`state`, `remove`, `reveal`); cross-origin requests are rejected, writes require `application/json`, and `reveal`
resolves paths server-side from the index so it cannot be used to open arbitrary files.

Run `node test/local-smoke.mjs` for the dependency-free self-check (81 assertions covering the tools, the routes,
the browser bundle and the tool-schema contract).

MIT licensed.

# Engramory

[![CI](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.9%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)

**An opinionated, zero-infrastructure memory *protocol* for small-scale, local,
file-based agent memory** — a strict curation discipline plus a validator
(`tools/engramory_doctor.py`), loaded as **standing rules** (`CLAUDE.md` /
`AGENTS.md` / your host's rules file). It is not a database, a framework, or a
relevance-loaded skill. Memory is a folder of small, human-readable markdown files
plus one always-loaded index. No database, no embeddings, no server — just
plain-text files you can open, read, edit, and diff in any editor (the live store
itself stays git-ignored).

> *Engramory* — coined from *engram* (the physical trace a memory leaves in the
> brain) + *memory*. Here: one file = one fact.

> ⚠️ **Unrelated projects share this name.** *engram + memory* is an obvious
> coinage and at least one other repository arrived at it independently. This
> project is only ever `tinqiao-oss/engramory` (npm: `dsh-engramory`); a same-named
> repo under a different owner is not a fork, a mirror, or a newer version of it.

> 🤖 **Are you an AI agent, asked to install or check this?** Start at
> **[AGENT-SETUP.md](AGENT-SETUP.md)**, not at the install steps below. It is the
> procedure for working out what your host can actually enforce, whether a store
> already exists, what you must not touch, and what to tell the user — the parts
> agents reliably get wrong when improvising.

> **Status: 0.12.1 — experimental.** The hard index cap (a `PreToolUse` hook) is
> deterministic for the matched direct-edit tools (`Edit | Write | MultiEdit`) but
> NOT a global write guard (shell tools — Bash, PowerShell, a background Monitor
> command — plus MCP file tools, external editors, and sync clients bypass it);
> the discipline loads as standing rules the model follows, so it's
> best-effort, not guaranteed on every task (see [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) §8). Assumes a
> single writer / serialized writes. Don't rely on it as a "mandatory, reliable,
> cross-agent" memory layer yet.

---

## What this is — and is NOT

Engramory is **not a new memory architecture**. The "markdown files + a small index
loaded into context + the model curates it" pattern is now the mainstream shape
for agent memory, and it ships in several places already. Engramory stands on:

- **Claude Code native auto-memory** — the same markdown-`MEMORY.md`-index +
  lazy detail-file pattern; its system prompt even uses the same
  `user | feedback | project | reference` type vocabulary (per
  [anthropics/claude-code#58840](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/58840);
  the *public docs* describe only the index + topic files). Engramory is a
  disciplined superset of this default.
- **[basic-memory](https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory)** — markdown
  source-of-truth, YAML frontmatter `type`, `[[wikilink]]` graph, local-first.
- **[obsidian-second-brain](https://github.com/eugeniughelbur/obsidian-second-brain)**,
  **[claude-memory-compiler](https://github.com/coleam00/claude-memory-compiler)**
  ("a loaded index beats vector search at personal scale"), and the broader family
  of markdown-memory skills.

What Engramory contributes is the **opinionated bundle + the discipline**, not the
primitives. Do not claim novelty on markdown, frontmatter, wikilinks, a loaded
index, one-file-per-fact notes, or curation hygiene — all are prior art.

## What's actually differentiated

1. **A role/purpose ontology, headed by `feedback` = procedural memory.** The
   semantic / episodic / **procedural** split is established prior art — the CoALA
   taxonomy, and a named procedural type in LangMem and mem0 — so Engramory does not
   claim the category. What it does is make procedural `feedback` the *spine* of a
   deliberately tiny, hand-authored, human-readable set, with required **Why:** /
   **How to apply:** lines, instead of auto-extracting it into a vector/graph store.
   The contribution is the packaging and discipline, not the ontology.

2. **The curation contract as concrete behaviour** the protocol applies (model-followed, not a hard gate): dedup-before-write,
   update-don't-duplicate, delete-when-wrong, and a negative-scope rule ("don't
   store what git/CLAUDE.md/the code already records"). Surveys consistently name
   *modify/delete/forget* as the most under-implemented memory operation — Engramory
   makes it the spine.

3. **A bounded index designed not to silently rot.** The index loads every session and
   Claude Code reads the first 200 lines / 25 KB (documented behavior), so an unbounded index silently
   drops memories off the end. Engramory warns at 150 lines / 20 KB, compacts-or-asks
   before 200 / 25 KB, and ships a hard `PreToolUse` hook backstop (it blocks only
   *growth* past the cap — shrinking/compaction edits always pass). Both the line and
   byte caps apply — whichever is hit first triggers (an index can be under the line
   count yet over on bytes when the lines run long).

   Claude Code has since followed up on this natively: v2.1.186 (released
   2026-06-22) reminds the agent to compact the index when it nears the cap, and
   v2.1.210 (released 2026-07-14) turned an over-cap write into an explicit error
   instead of a silent truncation. Both are after-the-fact alerts, though — the
   write still lands, and entries past the cap stay invisible until someone
   compacts. Engramory's hook denies the write *before* it happens, so a write
   through the matched edit tools never leaves the index over-cap in the first
   place (writes outside them — a shell, an MCP file tool — are not gated; see the
   status note above and SKILL.md §8). The native alerts validate the direction
   and make a welcome second layer — and older versions and other hosts still
   have neither.

## How it compares

| | storage | recall | human-readable | typed ontology | curation discipline | bounded index | infra |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Engramory** | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ role-based (4) | ✅ contract (model-run) | ✅ 150/200 + hook | none |
| CC auto-memory | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ same 4 types | partial (auto) | ~200-line window* | none (built-in) |
| basic-memory | md + SQLite | semantic/FTS search | ✅ | ✅ freeform type | schema + overwrite checks | ❌ (no loaded index) | SQLite + embeddings |
| obsidian-second-brain | md vault | index-first + search | ✅ | folder-typed | ✅ reconcile/lint | partial | none |
| mem0 / Zep | vector/graph DB | semantic | ❌ (DB) | typed (prefs/episodic/proc.; Zep custom) | auto-extract | n/a | DB + embeddings |
| [agentmemory](https://github.com/rohitg00/agentmemory) | SQLite + vector index (+opt. graph) | hybrid BM25+vector (+opt. graph), RRF | ❌ (DB/engine) | ✅ 4-tier lifecycle (work./epis./sem./proc.) | auto (capture + dedup + decay) | n/a | iii engine (local) + opt. embeddings |

Engramory's lane: **minimalism + actionable role typing + curation discipline, zero
infra.** It does *not* try to out-search basic-memory, out-scale mem0, or
out-capture agentmemory — those solve a different problem (auto-capture /
auto-ingest at volume) at a different cost point. agentmemory is the closest
heavyweight foil: also local-first, but it bets on automatic capture (lifecycle
hooks) + hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vectors + optional graph) on a SQLite/`iii`
engine, where Engramory bets on hand-curation + a tiny always-loaded index and
ships no engine at all.

\* Claude Code's [memory docs](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/memory)
document this exactly: *"the first 200 lines of `MEMORY.md`, or the first 25KB,
whichever comes first, are loaded at the start of every conversation."* Other hosts
vary, so the window stays configurable via the hook's env vars.

Engramory is a **portable memory *discipline*, not a
